delivery_options.name: Same-Day Delivery
delivery_options.target_areas: Colombo Metro and immediate Western Province suburbs
delivery_options.timing: Usually available before the local cutoff, commonly 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM. Later orders usually move to next-day handling.
delivery_options.best_used_for: Fresh cakes, flowers, groceries, and last-minute gift sets

delivery_options.name: Standard Delivery
delivery_options.target_areas: Island-wide major provincial capitals and regional districts
delivery_options.timing: Usually 1 to 3 business days depending on distance from the Colombo fulfillment hub.
delivery_options.best_used_for: Packaged items, electronics, clothing, and non-perishable goods

delivery_options.name: Scheduled Delivery
delivery_options.timing: Customer selects a delivery date at checkout, subject to item and address support.
delivery_options.best_used_for: Birthdays, anniversaries, celebration cakes, and customized gift hampers

delivery_options.name: Midnight / Specific-Time Delivery
delivery_options.timing: Requires hotline or live coordination and may carry a surcharge.

general_policies: Standard deliveries are typically routed before 5:30 PM, but exact hour-by-hour guarantees are not standard.
Preferred timeframes can be requested, but exact slots require live confirmation.
Couriers may call the recipient before delivery to verify availability.
Failed delivery because the recipient is unavailable can result in an extra charge for a second attempt, especially for perishable goods.
Cash on Delivery, cards, bank transfers, and digital wallets may be available depending on checkout eligibility.
Delivery charges are dynamic and calculated at checkout from the item, destination, and distance.

tiers.name: Tier 1
tiers.label: Western Province priority coverage
tiers.timing: Highest same-day reliability for many supported products when ordered before cutoff.
tiers.same_day_guidance: Same-day is commonly available for supported products, especially fresh cakes, flowers, groceries, and gift sets.
tiers.cutoff_guidance: Typical same-day cutoff is around 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM.
tiers.perishable_guidance: Perishables are most feasible in this tier, subject to item availability and checkout confirmation.

tiers.name: Tier 2
tiers.label: Major provincial hubs
tiers.timing: Fast standard delivery, often 1 to 2 days. Selected same-day may be possible only for specific items and early orders.
tiers.same_day_guidance: Same-day is limited and usually needs very early ordering and live confirmation.
tiers.cutoff_guidance: If same-day is possible, cutoff may be earlier, around 8:30 AM to 10:00 AM.
tiers.perishable_guidance: Fresh or sensitive items need item-level confirmation before promising delivery.

tiers.name: Tier 3
tiers.label: Island-wide and regional capitals
tiers.timing: Usually 2 to 3 business days for standard shipping.
tiers.same_day_guidance: Same-day should not be assumed in this tier.
tiers.cutoff_guidance: Regional delivery timing depends on item and checkout routing.
tiers.perishable_guidance: Warm restaurant food and sensitive fresh cream cakes are generally restricted or unavailable.
